IIM CAT Admission Online Form 2026 – Extend - Complete Details

Short Information : Indian Institutes of Management (IIMs) has released the Notification for the Common Admission Test (CAT-2026) For Post Graduate Programmes in Management IIM CAT 2026 Admission Test on the official website of the IIM CAT recently. Applications for the IIM CAT Admission Online Form 2026 has Started on 03 August 2026, & candidate can apply until 22 September 2026. The online examination will held on 29 November 2026. Candidates are advised to check the complete details for IIM CAT Admission Online Form 2026 given below..

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 03 August 2026
  • Last Date : 22 September 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 22 September 2026
  • Exam Date : 29 November 2026
  • Admit Card Available : 04 November 2026
  • Result/ Score Card : will be updated here soon

Application Fee

  • General, OBC, EWS Candidates : Rs. 2700/-
  • SC, ST Candidates : Rs. 1350/-
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.
